title: GitPush
description: Push an employee branch of one repository with a one-job write token; refspec target must be refs/heads/thread/<thread_no>/<employee>.

remote_url.description: Clone and push URL for a repository the daemon does not reach at git_base_url/<repo>.git: a standalone Git repository's upstream (git-repos.md §5), HTTPS without credentials, ssh:// or scp-like. Credentials come from cred.request with the URL's host and path (SSH: through the git-ssh wrapper). Absent: git_base_url/<repo>.git.

force_with_lease.description: Expected remote sha; only for member branches after conflict repair.

unchanged_against.description: Branches (thread branch, base) whose commits are not the employee's work: when HEAD has no commit outside them the push is skipped and the result says unchanged.
